# Branch audit — 26 September 2026

Base: `32ba8b13410c509a62af15a67baf4dce6ec86beb`.
Working branch: `site-audit-26sep2026`.
Core correction commit: `95336b442694459dc70dc20fe70c9dc64f4227a7`.
Status: review branch only; no merge or publication by this task.

## Implemented

Bilingual terminology and content alignment; correction of the TEI expansion; current Oxygen installation route with built-in-support caveat; qualified attribute instructions; resource categories; one principal heading per page; home feature heading hierarchy; skip links, explicit focus styling and current-page labels; mixed-direction handling; Arabic font requests on English pages; wrapping for long links; reduced-motion support; stable project IDs; reciprocal language/canonical metadata; text Open Graph metadata; bilingual 404; sitemap/robots; removal of .DS_Store and addition of .gitignore. Existing membership, email addresses and the MECANO/GALex/KnowBridge entry are preserved.

Contribution guidance, five issue templates, a PR template and proposals are separate from the core correction commit. They remain subject to curator review.

## Verification actually performed

- 240 local structural/link-target/pairing checks passed.
- 36 Chromium page/viewport cases passed: nine pages at widths 320, 375, 768 and 1440 pixels.
- Checks included horizontal overflow, first-tab skip link, focus visibility, skip-target focus and reduced-motion behavior where applicable.
- Thirteen changed/new text files in the core commit matched the local tested copy byte-for-byte using Git blob SHA-1.
- Representative English/Arabic desktop and mobile renders inspected.

The browser environment could not access external networks. HTML and the same CSS were rendered locally; font requests were disabled, so screenshots use fallback fonts. These tests do not certify Google Fonts loading, online navigation/HTTP status, live Pages deployment, all external resources, all browsers, or screen-reader accessibility. They are not a full WCAG conformance audit. A failed fetch was not classified as a broken link.

## Corrections to the preliminary audit language

No custom focus-visible rule does not prove an absence of native keyboard focus. An unprotected collaborative main branch is not itself a security incident. Oxygen's double-click behavior is valid when a named start tag is visible; it was clarified rather than removed. Encoding Cases and Pattern Library are development proposals, not automatically meeting decisions.
